description.value:
Requirements You're adjacent to an enemy larger than you.

Using a technique pioneered by goblins, you conceal your movements from a larger creature and hit them where it hurts. You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Quick Alchemy] to create a bomb or quick vial, then Strike an adjacent creature that's larger than you with it; neither action triggers reactions from the target of your Strike. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] to your Strike, but the bomb doesn't deal its splash damage.

Special If you have the Quick Bomber feat, you can Step after making the Strike, though you must remain adjacent to the required creature.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
